in_marathi.name: Ritika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ritika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'riti', meaning 'value' or 'rule'. In Hindu mythology, Ritika is the name of the divine goddess of speech and knowledge. She is the embodiment of wisdom, eloquence, and beauty. The name signifies a beloved or favorite one, cherished for her virtues and intelligence.
